subject: Air freight quote request to RUH
body:
Dear Air Freight Team,

Could you please quote an all-in price in EUR for the fastest air freight option to RUH (Riyadh, SA)? Please arrange truck pickup from our site in 21505 (Lueneburg), Germany, and include transport to the departure airport in your quote.

The furniture samples will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-29. The shipment consists of 9 pieces, with a gross weight of 294 kg and a total volume of 1.53 cbm.

Please attach your offer as a PDF to your reply so that our purchasing department can file it.

Thank you for your assistance.

Kind regards
Anna Sonnberg
Head of Purchasing and Logistics
Sonnberg Kaffeeroesterei GmbH

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting an all-in quote for a new shipment to Riyadh.
